title: I often return to this nonsensical mixture of Costco and Home Depot
content: I often go shopping here and often times the items are massive and thrown all over the place. There's different departments like electronics with random computers and Playstations, and a bathroom sink department, there's fruit stations and groceries but the isles are all so high up to the ceiling and it's almost always an ominous feeling. I'm always by myself and one time my exbf tried to kill me by following me inside with a knife so I had to hide until I woke up.
